tweaks.name: Disable Diagnostic Telemetry
tweaks.descriptionSimple: Stops Windows from sending detailed diagnostic data to Microsoft.
tweaks.gamingImpact: Saves slight background CPU and network bandwidth.

tweaks.name: Disable Advertising ID
tweaks.descriptionSimple: Prevents apps from tracking you with a unique ad profile.

tweaks.name: Disable Activity History
tweaks.descriptionSimple: Stops Windows from collecting timeline activities across devices.

tweaks.name: Disable Automatic App Installations (Consumer Features)
tweaks.descriptionSimple: Stops Windows from automatically installing sponsored junk like TikTok or Candy Crush.
tweaks.gamingImpact: Prevents surprise background downloads while playing online games.

tweaks.name: Disable Bing Web Search in Start Menu
tweaks.descriptionSimple: When you search in the Start Menu, it only searches your computer, not Bing web results.
tweaks.gamingImpact: Makes Start menu search 10x faster and eliminates web requests.

tweaks.name: Restore Classic Windows 10 Context Menu
tweaks.descriptionSimple: Restores the fast right-click menu without having to click 'Show more options'.

tweaks.name: Show Known File Extensions
tweaks.descriptionSimple: Always shows .exe, .zip, .ini so you don't accidentally open malicious files.
tweaks.gamingImpact: Crucial for modding games and editing config files.

tweaks.name: Remove 10-Second Windows Startup Delay
tweaks.descriptionSimple: Removes the artificial 10-second wait Windows applies to startup applications.
tweaks.gamingImpact: PC boots to a responsive desktop faster.

tweaks.name: Disable Windows Copilot AI
tweaks.descriptionSimple: Disables the Copilot AI assistant sidebar and hotkey.

tweaks.name: Disable Windows Recall AI Screenshots
tweaks.descriptionSimple: Disables the 26H2 AI feature that takes screenshots of your activity for search.
tweaks.gamingImpact: Huge disk write & NPU savings. Essential for gaming privacy.

tweaks.name: Disable VBS / Memory Integrity (Expert)
tweaks.descriptionSimple: WARNING: Lowers kernel security layer in exchange for ~5-10% more FPS in CPU-bound games.
tweaks.gamingImpact: Measurable 5-10% FPS improvement in competitive shooters (Valorant, CS2, Warzone).
